name: One-Year Lump-Sum Investment
description: Pay a lump sum once and earn interest on the invested amount over a 12-month contract.
benefits: Access to loan facilities
Stand as guarantor for other people’s loans of 1% to 80% of your invested amount
No collateral on loans that fall within your invested amount
18% interest on the invested amount
clauses: The plan cannot be terminated before the maturity of the contract.
If the contract must be terminated before it expires, the whole interest shall be forfeited.
Terminating the contract within the first 30 days attracts a 5% penalty, deducted from the amount invested.
You can only stand as guarantor for another person if your active investment’s maturity date matches the last repayment date of the guaranteed person’s loan.
If a person you guarantee cannot repay their loan as agreed, the loan deduction and interest shall be deducted from your investment account.
You must give 5 working days’ notice for a contract termination request to be processed for payment.

name: Two or More Years Lump-Sum Investment
description: Pay a lump sum once for a contract of more than 12 months, with interest paid yearly.
benefits: Access to loan facilities

No collateral on loans that fall within your invested amount
18% interest on the invested amount, paid yearly
clauses: The plan cannot be terminated before the maturity of the contract.

name: Monthly Savings Investment Plan (MSP)
description: Save every month for as long as you choose and earn interest on your savings.
benefits: Access to loan facilities
No collateral on loans that fall within your current invested amount
Stand as guarantor for other people’s loans of 1% to 50% of your invested amount as of the date of need
Partial withdrawal after the 8th month
10% commission on a contract that lasts 12 months
clauses: The plan cannot be terminated before the maturity of the contract.
If the contract must be terminated before maturity, the whole interest shall be forfeited.
Terminating the contract within the first 30 days attracts a 5% penalty, deducted from the amount invested.
You must give 5 working days’ notice for a contract termination request to be processed for payment.
You can only stand as guarantor for another person if your active investment’s maturity date matches the last repayment date of the guaranteed person’s loan.
If a person you guarantee cannot repay their loan as agreed, the loan deduction and interest shall be deducted from your investment account.
Partial withdrawal can only be made after the 8th month of the 12-month contract, and interest is then calculated on your current invested capital only.
Savings must be made as agreed in the contract; missed savings attract a penalty on the interest.

name: Monthly Collection (MC)
description: Set aside an amount daily or weekly, collected at the end of one month. No interest attached.
benefits: Access to loan facilities
clauses: Eligibility for loan facilities is determined by management.
Loan facility limits are determined by management.
You must give 24 hours’ notice when requesting a withdrawal before the month ends.

name: Quarterly Collection (QC)
description: Set aside an amount daily or weekly, collected every quarter, and earn 2.5% interest.
benefits: Access to loan facilities
Interest of 2.5% on savings
clauses: Eligibility for loan facilities is determined by management.
Loan facilities cannot be more than ₦50,000.

name: Accessible Savings Account (ASA)
description: Save and withdraw at any point in time.
benefits: Withdraw at any time
Access to loan facilities based on your saving history
clauses: Eligibility for loan facilities is determined by management.
Loan facility limits are determined by management.

name: Salary Advance
description: Borrow against your salary if you work under an employment contract, and repay when your salary is paid.
benefits: Fast access to funds before payday
Repaid in one instalment when your salary is paid
requirements: You must be under an employment contract
Proof of income, e.g. bank statement or pay slip

name: House Rent Loan
description: Pay off or balance your rent, and repay over an agreed period.
benefits: Pay your rent on time
Spread repayment over an agreed period
requirements: Evidence of cash reserves and assets

name: Academic Loan
description: Finance school fees and other academic costs, and repay over an agreed period.
benefits: Cover school fees and academic costs
Spread repayment over an agreed period

name: Business Loan
description: Funding to start or grow your business, repaid over an agreed period.
benefits: Working capital for your business
Weekly or monthly repayment

name: Phone / Gadget / Laptop Loan
description: Borrow to buy a phone, gadget or laptop, and repay over an agreed period.
benefits: Get the device you need now
Weekly or monthly repayment

name: Home Appliances Loan
description: Borrow to buy home appliances, and repay over an agreed period.
benefits: Equip your home now
Weekly or monthly repayment

name: Hire-Purchase: Electronics
description: Get phones, laptops, home appliances and other electronics now, and pay in instalments.
benefits: Take the item home now
Pay in weekly or monthly instalments
clauses: Ownership of the item transfers to you only after full payment of all instalments.
Guarantor details are mandatory as part of the application.
The item requested determines the interest rate used to calculate your repayments.
